title: Palm Beach vs. Miami Bridal Makeup Styles: Finding Your Perfect Look
excerpt: Discover how your Florida wedding location can inspire a bridal beauty aesthetic that feels completely and authentically you.
content: Palm Beach brides often gravitate toward refined elegance — think luminous skin, champagne-toned shadows, and a timeless sophistication that mirrors the venue's old-world grandeur. Miami brides, by contrast, tend to embrace bold contrast, bronzed warmth, and editorial drama that commands attention under rooftop lights. Understanding which aesthetic resonates with your personality and setting helps your makeup artist craft a look that feels intentional, not just beautiful.

title: Palm Beach vs. Miami Bridal Makeup Styles: Which Is Right for You?
excerpt: Discover how Palm Beach's timeless elegance and Miami's bold glamour inspire two distinct bridal makeup aesthetics for Florida brides.
content: Palm Beach brides tend to favor refined, sun-kissed looks with soft peach tones, barely-there liners, and luminous skin that feels effortlessly chic. Miami brides, on the other hand, embrace dramatic definition — think sculpted contour, rich lip colors, and bold lashes that command the dance floor. At Velora Bella, we help you identify which aesthetic resonates with your wedding vision and craft a personalized look that feels authentically you.
